description: Source code for CUDA-specific grouped matrix multiplication (GEMM) operations in PyTorch's ATen library, including functions for different quantization schemes and hardware backends.

methods.name: _mx8_mx8_bf16_grouped_mm_mslk
methods.description: Performs 2D-2D or 2D-3D grouped GEMM with MXFP8 quantization using MSLK library, CUDA-only.

methods.name: _f8_f8_bf16_rowwise_grouped_mm_cuda
methods.description: Performs row-wise scaled grouped GEMM for FP8 quantization on CUDA.

methods.name: _f8_f8_bf16_rowwise_grouped_mm_rocm
methods.description: Performs row-wise scaled grouped GEMM for FP8 quantization on ROCm.

methods.name: _f8_f8_bf16_rowwise_grouped_mm
methods.description: Dispatches between CUDA and ROCm implementations for FP8 row-wise scaled grouped GEMM.

methods.name: _f4_f4_bf16_grouped_mm_mslk
methods.description: Performs grouped GEMM with FP4 quantization using MSLK library, CUDA-only.

methods.name: check_scale
methods.description: Validates scale tensors for different quantization schemes.

methods.name: _scaled_grouped_mm_cuda
methods.description: Main entry point for CUDA-based scaled grouped GEMM with support for various quantization schemes.

methods.name: _scaled_grouped_mm_cuda_v2
methods.description: Enhanced version of scaled grouped GEMM supporting multiple quantization schemes and dispatching.

methods.name: _grouped_mm_cuda
methods.description: Performs standard grouped GEMM on CUDA, with fallback and ROCm support.
